typed_rule: Preserve each native object's role/type/policy scope/epoch and permit merge/reuse only when every system-specific load-bearing premise remains established under that system's native semantics. Unknown native premises remain UNKNOWN/CANNOT_CHECK.
information_matching: No baseline is denied native metadata required by its natural interface. The typed arm may use only the prospectively registered type/scope/epoch bindings, not hidden outcomes.
promotion_gate: At least two systems must contain discriminating machine-authoritative cases where typed versus flat/native-only handling differ; typed rule must have zero unsafe approvals on decidable cases.
stop_rule: A native system whose semantics do not instantiate the shared question is reported non-discriminating; it is not recoded after outcomes to manufacture a difference.
